import os, sys, tempfile, threading, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/trey-agent/Code/delegate-agent/.worktrees/plan-burndown-r2-review-SR-refuter-0/src")
from delegate_agent.private_io import read_private_text_bounded, BoundedReadError

# A work child that owns .delegate spins os.replace on one record (the exact
# tamper threat model the docstring names). Measure what ONE parent read costs.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    path = Path(tmp) / "record"
    path.write_text("x" * 4096, encoding="utf-8")
    stop = threading.Event()
    def spinner():
        i = 0
        while not stop.is_set():
            c = Path(tmp) / f".spin-{i%4}"
            c.write_text("y" * 4096, encoding="utf-8")
            os.replace(c, path)
            i += 1
    ts = [threading.Thread(target=spinner, daemon=True) for _ in range(4)]
    for t in ts: t.start()
    time.sleep(0.2)
    worst = 0.0; fails = 0; n = 40
    for _ in range(n):
        t0 = time.monotonic()
        try: read_private_text_bounded(path, max_bytes=1 << 20)
        except BoundedReadError as e:
            fails += 1
        dt = time.monotonic() - t0
        worst = max(worst, dt)
    stop.set()
    for t in ts: t.join(timeout=2)
    print(f"reads={n} refusals={fails} worst_single_read_seconds={worst:.4f}")
EOF
